import pandas as pd
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('2015.csv')

# Extract relevant columns for linear regression
X = df[['Economy (GDP per Capita)']]
y = df['Health (Life Expectancy)']

# Perform linear regression
model = LinearRegression()
model.fit(X, y)
y_pred = model.predict(X)

# Calculate R-squared
r_squared = round(r2_score(y, y_pred), 2)

# Determine model fit
model_fit = "good fit" if r_squared >= 0.7 else "poor fit"

print(f"@coefficient_determination[{r_squared}], @model_fit[{model_fit}]")
